title: Which Attribute Is the Barrier?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Name the innovation attribute that is the barrier behind each of eight teacher comments about a new tool.

learningObjectives: The learner will attribute each of eight teacher comments to the innovation attribute that is the barrier, correctly attributing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Relative advantage, compatibility, complexity, trialability, and observability, from the section "The Five Innovation Attributes" in Chapter 15.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: "It would mean giving up the group discussions I believe in." Which attribute?
"The contract is for three years with no exit." Which attribute?
commonMisconceptions: Every adoption problem is a training problem
Teachers who do not adopt are resistant
Complexity and compatibility are the same
assessmentOpportunities: "It would mean giving up the group discussions I believe in." Which attribute?
"The contract is for three years with no exit." Which attribute?
Are complexity and compatibility the same?
Is every adoption problem a training problem?

controls.name: 5 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the attributes; two tries per comment.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Opens a table of the attributes and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
